{{Quote|Doctor Shinss is a brilliant scientist. His research actually led to the development of the Death Star's power cells. Not only is he in charge of the Yavin salvage operation, he is slated to begin work on a new project in the Endor system.|Inquisitor Vrke|<ref name="SWG:IDSY" />}}
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Shinss''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:IDSY" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCivilian.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Doctor Shinss]]
Shinss appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IDSY" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Doctor Shinss was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:IDSY" />
